messages:
anya: Quick sync 1 min: we need a concrete plan for Private deploys focusing on egress IP stability during operator upgrades, a rollback runbook, and an airgap installer under 200MB. Keep scope tight.

devin: From eng, main risk is cold cache after revert. Proposal: canary + auto-rollback if kv-hit-rate drops > 20% for 10m.

lee: For egress preservation options: host-affinity SNAT, announce via relay, or let customers use external NAT. Recommend default preserve-on-upgrade with opt-out flag.

morgan: Field asks: comms template + verification steps. Customers want a one-page checklist for peering owners. I'll collect 3 beta customers.

ci-bot: Pipeline created: ci/private-upgrade-canary-1799998000.

anya: Sprint split: sprint 1 = preserve-egress toggle + canary + rollback docs. sprint 2 = slim airgap bundle + KMS proof-of-concept + GA comms. Gate criteria will be in confluence.

devin: Installer flags: --network-mode=preserve|relay|external --airgap=true|false. Will add verifier that prints final egress IP and bundle checksum.

lee: Security note: airgap must not phone home by default; telemetry opt-in only with hashed install id.

morgan: I'll prepare comms and schedule beta week. Need deliverables one week before handoff.

anya: Owners: devin -> canary & rollback; lee -> network fallback + preserve flow; morgan -> comms & beta. Review Fri 10am PT. Drop blockers here. :thumbsup:
